mentions.name: Colanode
mentions.description: An open-source, self-hostable workspace that brings chat, docs, databases, and files into one place. It is local-first: data lives on your devices first, everything works instantly and offline, syncing happens in the background, and infrastructure stays minimal so users keep full control of their data.
mentions.problem: Closes the gap between the convenience of cloud tools and the ownership of local software; typical SaaS tools don't let users keep full control of their data.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m working on Colanode, which is built to close the gap between the convenience of cloud tools and the ownership of local software. It brings chat, docs, databases, and files into one open-source, self-hostable workspace where data lives on your devices first and syncs in the background.
